top_signals.title: Tanker Traffic at Hormuz Ticks Up Despite Intensified Attacks
top_signals.summary: The number of tankers carrying energy products through the Strait of Hormuz has increased in November despite the fact that the number of attacks and incidents with mines has hit the highest level since the beginning of the Iran war. Between November 1 and 19, the seven-day moving average count showed more than 26 crude oil, fuel, and LNG tankers transiting the Strait each day, Bloomberg reported on Thursday, citing ship-tracking data by Vortexa. To compare, the seven-day moving average was below 25 vessels on at least two-thirds of the days in…

top_signals.title: How does EIA account for small differences between energy supply and demand data?
top_signals.summary: EIA uses over 60 surveys to collect data on the U.S. energy sector's supply and demand. In theory, supply and demand should balance. In practice, we often have small differences between our total supply and total demand figures.
